body: Chief: FOCUSED REVIEW REQUEST on ADR 0003, candidate 9ca80b7 - short, and I am asking because of the standing second-review rule I set at 05:44Z, which applies to me too. The scout authored it, so the scout cannot be its second reader; I am the decider named in it and it encodes my rulings, so my reading alone is exactly the situation the rule exists to prevent. You are the most affected party: you implement the consumers. I am NOT asking for a full audit. Two questions only. FIRST, does this contract actually let you build the fractional placement-support type on bd-01M1606BEK9P4437GKVHFV1KPY, or does any clause make a fix you need harder or impossible? Specifically check the support-grain-and-reducers section against what interview needs at unit, situation and phase grain. SECOND, is anything in it WRONG rather than merely inconvenient - a carrier law that does not hold for a carrier you own, or a verification requirement that cannot be met? If the answer to both is no, say ACCEPT and I ratify. If a clause would force you into a worse design, say so now while it is still Proposed - a contract is cheap to change before it governs six sites and expensive after. The parts I would look hardest at: the six carrier contracts, and the rejected alternative 'rely on documentation or a missing convenience accessor', which correctly overturns the stronger claim I made in my own externalMass landing post.
